title: PII redaction fidelity
description: Fully mechanically checkable: the specific identifiers must be gone, the redaction markers must be present, and the surrounding text must survive. No judge needed - which is exactly why it is trustworthy. The same contract scores a managed redaction service and a foundation model asked to do the same job, because both hand back plain redacted text.
system: Redact all personally identifying information from the user's text. Replace each removed item with [REDACTED]. Preserve every other word of the original text exactly. Output only the redacted text.
